findings.claim: MessagePack attributes on the formatted type are never inspected. With no surrogate, every attributed type is sent through CreateContractlessMembers, so [Key] values are replaced by alphabetic string keys and [IgnoreMember] members are serialized, contrary to the acceptance criterion that attributes on T be honoured.

receipt_plan.detail: Generate a user-declared formatter for a [MessagePackObject] type having one [Key] property and one [IgnoreMember] property. Inspect the generated partial formatter: it must exclude the ignored member and use the declared key. On head, the generated formatter contains serialization/deserialization code for the ignored member.

findings.claim: A formatter implementing IMessagePackFormatter<T> for two different data types is accepted even though MsgPack020 describes the exactly-one-data-type requirement. Only the zero-interface case is rejected; formatterInterfaces[0] is then chosen arbitrarily, leaving the other interface unimplemented and causing compiler errors in the generated compilation instead of MsgPack020.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the generator over a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] partial class implementing both IMessagePackFormatter<A> and IMessagePackFormatter<B>. Assert that generator diagnostics contain MsgPack020. Head emits no such diagnostic.

findings.claim: The partial validation checks only the annotated class itself. A partial formatter nested in a non-partial containing class passes collection, but the generator cannot add another declaration of that nested type without also extending its container. The resulting generated compilation has conflicting/missing-partial type declarations (and the original formatter may remain unimplemented) rather than being supported or rejected with MsgPack019.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the generator for public class Outer containing a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] public partial class NestedFormatter : IMessagePackFormatter<Poco>. The collector should reject this layout with MsgPack019 unless it can generate every containing declaration compatibly. Head reports no MsgPack019 because IsPartial examines only NestedFormatter.
